import os

cityscapes = ''/Users/qbit-glitch/Desktop/datasets/cityscapes''

npz_dir = f''{cityscapes}/pseudo_instance/train/aachen''

    inst_png = np.array\(Image.open\(png_path\)\)
    print\(f''\\n=== Instance PNG: {sorted\(png_files\)[0]} ===''\)

        if uid == 0: continue
        area = \(inst_png == uid\).sum\(\)
        pct = area / inst_png.size * 100
        print\(f''    Instance {uid}: area={area} \({pct:.1f}%\)''\)

# Also check NPZ masks more carefully
npz_files = [f for f in os.listdir\(npz_dir\) if f.endswith\(''.npz''\)]

    print\(f''  Total mask pixels per mask:''\)
    for i in range\(num_valid\):
        print\(f''    Mask {i}: {masks[i].sum\(\)} / {masks.shape[1]} pixels = {masks[i].sum\(\)/masks.shape[1]*100:.1f}%''\)
")

import numpy as np
import os

    ''aachen/aachen_000000_000019_leftImg8bit.npz'',
    ''bochum/bochum_000000_000600_leftImg8bit.npz'',
    ''cologne/cologne_000000_000736_leftImg8bit.npz'',
    ''hamburg/hamburg_000000_000042_leftImg8bit.npz'',
    ''strasbourg/strasbourg_000000_000369_leftImg8bit.npz'',
]

for s in samples:
    path = f''{cityscapes}/pseudo_instance/train/{s}''
    if not os.path.exists\(path\):

        continue
    data = np.load\(path\)
    masks = data[''masks'']
    nv = int\(data[''num_valid'']\)
    N = masks.shape[1]
    city = s.split\(''/''\)[0]
    sizes = [masks[i].sum\(\)/N*100 for i in range\(nv\)]

# Also check val stats
print\(\)

if os.path.exists\(val_stats_path\):

import sys, os, time
sys.path.insert\(0, ''.''\)
os.environ[''PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK''] = ''1''
os.environ[''PYTORCH_MPS_HIGH_WATERMARK_RATIO''] = ''0.0''

import torch
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

# Quick test: extract features from 3 images, K-means K=5
from mbps_pytorch.generate_semantic_pseudolabels_unsupervised import \(
    create_feature_extractor, preprocess_image, extract_features_single,
    fit_kmeans, upsample_and_refine, _try_import_crf,
\)

device = ''mps''
model_name = ''facebook/dinov3-vitl16-pretrain-lvd1689m''

# Just test image loading + feature extraction on 1 image
data_dir = ''/Users/qbit-glitch/Desktop/datasets/cityscapes/leftImg8bit/train''
img_files = sorted\(Path\(data_dir\).rglob\(''*.png''\)\)[:3]
print\(f''Testing with {len\(img_files\)} images''\)

t0 = time.time\(\)
model, embed_dim, patch_size, skip_tokens = create_feature_extractor\(model_name, device\)
print\(f''Model loaded in {time.time\(\)-t0:.1f}s, embed_dim={embed_dim}''\)

all_feats = []
for img_path in img_files:
    t1 = time.time\(\)
    pv, orig = preprocess_image\(str\(img_path\), device\)
    feats, hp, wp = extract_features_single\(model, pv, skip_tokens\)
    print\(f''  {img_path.name}: features {feats.shape}, patches \({hp},{wp}\), {time.time\(\)-t1:.1f}s''\)
    all_feats.append\(feats\)

all_feats = np.concatenate\(all_feats, axis=0\)
print\(f''Total features: {all_feats.shape}''\)

# K-means with K=5
from sklearn.cluster import MiniBatchKMeans
kmeans = MiniBatchKMeans\(n_clusters=5, batch_size=1000, random_state=42, n_init=1, max_iter=50\)
kmeans.fit\(all_feats\)
labels = kmeans.predict\(all_feats[:2048]\)
print\(f''Labels unique: {np.unique\(labels\)}, shape: {labels.shape}''\)

# Test upsample
dcrf, unary = _try_import_crf\(\)
label_map = upsample_and_refine\(labels, str\(img_files[0]\), hp, wp, 5, True, dcrf, unary\)
print\(f''Label map: shape={label_map.shape}, dtype={label_map.dtype}, unique={np.unique\(label_map\)}''\)
print\(''SMOKE TEST PASSED''\)
")
